files.description: Order lines (300 rows): line_id (whole number), product (product name; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), quantity (whole number; about 3% empty), amount (line total, two decimals; about 3% empty).

task_text: For the order lines with an amount above 100, give the population variance (dividing by the number of values) of quantity and of amount, ignoring empty cells. `result` should be a Series indexed by quantity and amount.
intended_computation: Restrict to the 223 lines with amount > 100; for quantity and amount separately the variance with divisor n over the non-empty cells.

predicted_direction.reason: np.var on a DataFrame gave a variance per column on 2.x; on 3.x one variance of all cells together.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row I01; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
